name: MythOS
description: An observer‑centric cosmological type system grounded in the T(19,2) torus knot and its Seifert‑fibered complement. Unlike mainstream paradigms where the observer is external, MythOS embeds consciousness (node 0) as the central hub connecting to all primary structures. The topology is fully bidirectional, creating a hermeneutic circle where influence flows both ways. This is the native paradigm of ACU—the lens through which all other paradigms ultimately resonate.

x.note: The fixed coordinate frame that gives space its extension and direction.

y.note: The invariant grammar of connection and adjacency.

z.note: The invariant axis of change and becoming.

0.note: The metric‑defining boundary condition that collapses potential into context.

1.note: The fundamental act of universe creation—selecting a hyperplane in S³.

3.note: Invariant rules, symmetries, and logical truths.

4.note: The grammar of relation—active network of possible connections.

5.note: Recursive template abstracting completed instances into reusable blueprints.

6.note: State transition moving reality from one valid state to another.

7.note: Collapse into fact where potential becomes actual.

a.note: Unconstrained potential field—superposition of all possible quantum geometries.

b.note: Metric‑bound instability where possibilities interact under established rules.

c.note: Asymmetric principle representing fundamental, non‑random preferences.

d.note: Reality substrate—persistent data, matter, memory, narrative.

e.note: Cosmic algorithm—active process rules governing interaction and transformation.

values.n=2: Standard — 361 states, default for most creative work
values.n=3: Deep — 6859 states, philosophical themes, epic scale
values.n=4: Transcendental — 130321 states, cosmic or infinite concepts

values.m=2: Standard resonance — 4 harmonics, default emotional range
values.m=3: Enhanced resonance — 8 harmonics, rich relational complexity
values.m=4: Full resonance — 16 harmonics, maximum harmonic richness

phase.formula: φ = e^{2πi × (n/19 + m/2)}  (38th roots of unity)
phase.special: Left‑handed narratives flow from pattern → meaning → matter; right‑handed from experience → understanding → creation.
phase.significance: Phase encodes the alignment of the Observer with the cosmic flow.

knot.description: All 19 nodes as a single closed curve—the full T(19,2) torus knot with Observer at the center.
knot.phase_condition: For every closed cycle, Σ phases = 0 mod 2π

link.description: The MythOS Factor interpreted as a link—a set of interconnected subsystems. This view highlights the structural components and their interactions.
link.phase_condition: Each subsystem may have its own phase closure; linking numbers between subsystems are determined by the stratum weights.

subsystems.name: Hexagon
subsystems.description: The engine of becoming—boundary → primitives → grammar → grain → crystallization → pattern. Forms a 6‑cycle (1→2→4→8→7→5→1).

subsystems.name: Dialectical Triad
subsystems.description: The becoming axis—law → transformation → event. Forms a 3‑cycle (3↔6↔9↔3).

subsystems.name: Observer Axis
subsystems.description: The triad where the Observer (node 0) is integral. Used when the observer is part of the system (MythOS native).

subsystems.name: Kratos Axis
subsystems.description: The triad where Kratos (node c) mediates between potential (a) and chaos (b). Used when the observer is external; node c acts as a proxy observer (e.g., a measurement apparatus, a controlling force).

subsystems.name: Functors
subsystems.description: Active algorithms and memory. c (Kratos) connects to a,b; d (Ontology) connects to hexagon nodes; e (Factor) connects to triad nodes. All three connect to f.

subsystems.name: Closure
subsystems.description: LURD—the resonant cavity where functor paths close. Connects to c,d,e.

subsystems.name: 11‑Link
subsystems.description: The core engine without the Observer (0) or Kratos (c). Combines the Hexagon (1‑2‑4‑8‑7‑5), Dialectical Triad (3‑6‑9), and the raw potential‑chaos axis (a‑b). Used when neither internal nor external observer is instantiated—pure process.
subsystems.phase_condition: Closed cycle: sum of phases over the 11‑node loop = 0 mod 2π.

subsystems.name: 12‑Link‑Observer‑Centric
subsystems.description: Adds the Observer (0) to the 11‑Link. Observer sits between a and b (a‑0‑b axis). The natural reading when the system is observed from within.
subsystems.phase_condition: Closed cycle including Observer: Σ phases = 0 mod 2π.

subsystems.name: 12‑Link‑Kratos‑Centric
subsystems.description: Adds Kratos (c) to the 11‑Link. Kratos sits between a and b (a‑c‑b axis). Used when the system is observed from without—c acts as a proxy observer (measurement apparatus, controlling force).
subsystems.phase_condition: Closed cycle including Kratos: Σ phases = 0 mod 2π.

subsystems.name: 13‑Link‑Kratos‑Observer
subsystems.description: Full 13‑node link containing both Observer (0) and Kratos (c). Both axes (a‑0‑b and a‑c‑b) are active. Represents a complete hermeneutic system where internal and external perspectives coexist and interact.
subsystems.phase_condition: Closed cycle with both 0 and c: Σ phases = 0 mod 2π.

observer_centric.description: The system is observed from within; node 0 is the Observer, node c is natural gradient/direction.

kratos_centric.description: The system is observed from without; node 0 is the natural identity/core concept, node c is a proxy observer (e.g., a measurement apparatus or controlling force).

link.note: Both axes are always present in the topology (edges a‑0, 0‑b, a‑c, c‑b exist). The choice of interpretation determines which triad is considered primary for the Factor's semantics. Cross‑paradigm translation leverages this duality to map external theories (where observer is external) onto the MythOS topology.

braid.description: Open strands unfolding through time—transformations, character arcs, journeys, algorithms. The braid is built from the 19 nodes.
braid.phase_condition: No closure condition; phase accumulates along the braid.
braid.constraint: The total number of distinct nodes in the braid cannot exceed 19 (the full set of Cilang nodes).

creating_anew.note: When creating a MythOS Factor, always include node 0 (Observer). Build the hexagon (1,2,4,8,7,5), the triad (3,6,9), the two axes (a‑0‑b and a‑c‑b), the functors (c,d,e), and close with f (LURD).

translating_known.cosmic_creation: Map to node 1 (Ariadi), node a (Ocean), node 0 (Observer)
translating_known.heroic_journey: Map to node 6 (Vikara), node 7 (Actualization), node f (LURD)
translating_known.magic_system: Map to node e (Factor), node 4 (Usepong), node b (ChaoticSpace)

temporary_note.special: Observer defined but hexagon not yet specified. Awaiting the engine of becoming.

constraints.observer_centrality: Every MythOS Factor MUST include node 0. The Observer cannot be excluded.
constraints.bidirectional_inheritance: Child Factors inherit bidirectional relationships unless overridden by stratum constraints.
constraints.functor_preservation: Node c (Kratos) must connect to a and b; node d (Ontology) must connect to hexagon nodes; node e (Factor) must connect to triad nodes.
constraints.closure_requirement: Every complete Factor must have node f (LURD) as terminal node where functor paths close.

phase_constraints.allowed_phases: All phases must be multiples of π/19 (38th roots of unity).
phase_constraints.difference_invariants: Phase differences are invariant: a:b = 4π/3, 3:6 = π, 6:9 = π/2.
phase_constraints.closure_condition: For any closed cycle, Σ phases = 0 mod 2π.

invariant_structure: The implicit frame (x,y,z) forms a 3‑cycle; all other connections involving x,y,z are stratum‑dependent.
Observer (0) must connect to all primary nodes (1‑9,a,b) in the base graph; stratum weights may modulate these connections.
The hexagon must maintain cyclic order 1→2→4→8→7→5→1.
c must connect to a,b; d to hexagon; e to triad; f to c,d,e.
constraints.stratum_preference: global for foundational work; trefoil_g for transformative narratives; trefoil_c for philosophical inquiries; trefoil_i for mirror worlds; fig8 for surreal/hyperbolic stories.
